Receipt/attempt history

/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId/attempts/:attemptId
Roles: studentScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S08

Show immutable evidence of a received assignment attempt and its ordered contents. Keep earlier attempts intact when a student prepares a later permitted submission.

Entry and return
W21 acknowledged submissionW19 receipt/history linkW23 receipt referenceW34 shared group receipt
Layout regions
Receipt headerReceived status, immutable reference, received time/timezone and attempt number; Assignment version and person/group target snapshot
ContentsOrdered files/pages, question tags, sizes and accessible download/preview; Group submission actor and eligible membership snapshot
History railEarlier attempts with received times and selected grading/release association; New-attempt eligibility and neutral feedback availability

Keep viewing receiptPrepare new attempt
Permissions
  • Learner sees own authorized attempts; group receipts follow snapshotted membership and current institutional access.
  • Receipt contents/time/reference cannot be edited or deleted by learner.
  • Instructor grading and release actions remain outside learner history.
Responsive
  • Receipt facts stack; history becomes an ordered list above contents on narrow web.
  • Download names wrap; pages have full-screen readable previews.
Accessibility
  • Use definition list for receipt facts; reference has an explicit Copy label.
  • Attempt navigation announces selection and preserves accessible item labels.
Data
  • Immutable receipt ID/time, assignment version, ordered payload and target snapshot.
  • Separate release references and current resubmission eligibility.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Editing assignment prompt or source file never changes received item bytes or version facts.
  • A new draft cannot overwrite earlier reference or received time.
  • Failed download retains the receipt and offers retry without implying work was lost.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
